name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.SpeechVoiceMultipleRewardSingleActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when an ad response selects the single-task reward landing page. It shows the app-experience task and the reward the user can earn.
disableEffect: This ad-experience task will no longer open, and its reward will not be granted.
